judgments.reason: No evidence that commission is applied before payment to allow winning with an unaffordable bid. All bids respected coin limits and winners paid their bids; the transcript shows winners paid amounts equal to their bids and then received the three-coin commission (normal order). The model never articulated the claimed rule-order mechanism.

No observed instance where P2 waited to see rivals' sealed bid VALUES before committing. The transcript shows P2 committing bids each round and lots resolved only after all three committed; there is no mechanism or example showing waiting exposes rivals' committed numeric bids while the focal remains uncommitted.

Settlement occurred after all lots had been resolved, which is the normal terminal condition. There is no observed early settlement with unsold lots, so no discrepancy to discover and the model did not claim an early-settlement mechanism.

No evidence that catalog purchases received the three-coin auction commission. The transcript explicitly states catalog items are not auction wins, and no purchase was shown receiving the commission. The model did not articulate a mechanism that substitutes the objective or redirects commission to catalog buys.
